description: Build an Aviasurf live-search URL with dates, passenger composition, cabin class, currency, and locale. Always link the returned search_url from a short label in the answer language, for example "Check live prices on Aviasurf"; never paste the raw URL as text. This opens live search; it does not confirm a fare or availability.

currency.description: Three-letter output currency. Set it only when the user explicitly requests a currency; otherwise the service derives it from the departure country.

depart_date.description: Optional departure date to prefill in live search.

destination.description: Destination city or airport IATA code.

locale.description: Language locale for the live search page.

market.description: Two-letter country market. Set it only when the user explicitly requests a country market or local Aviasurf site; otherwise the service derives it from the departure country.

origin.description: Origin city or airport IATA code.

return_date.description: Optional return date to prefill in live search.

trip_class.description: Cabin class; human-readable names are preferred and Y/W/C/F are accepted aliases.

name: open_search
title: Open live Aviasurf search
